statement: ∀ (N : ℕ), 0 < N → ∀ t ∈ unitI, ∃ j : Fin N, t ∈ Set.Icc ((j : ℕ) / (N : ℝ)) (((j : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) / N)
proof:
intro N hN t ht
have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
rcases ht with ⟨ht0, ht1⟩
by_cases he : t = 1
· refine ⟨⟨N-1, by omega⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [he, div_le_iff₀ hNr]
    norm_cast
    omega
  · rw [he, le_div_iff₀ hNr]
    have h : ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_add_cancel hN)
    simpa only [Fin.val_mk, one_mul] using h.ge
· have htlt : t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht1 he
  have hf : ⌊t * (N : ℝ)⌋₊ < N := (Nat.floor_lt (by positivity)).2 (by nlinarith)
  refine ⟨⟨⌊t * (N : ℝ)⌋₊, hf⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [div_le_iff₀ hNr]
    exact Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ hNr]
    exact (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (t * (N : ℝ))).le
